caption: dnaA self-autoregulation vs no-autoregulation control. Feedback OFF (control) over-shoots — peak 1567, mean to 1178. Feedback ON caps the peak (1567->635, ~2.5x) and dampens the cell-cycle amplitude into the [300,800] band — the V-tension the dnaa-3 V-sweep proved no constitutive V could resolve. Trough sits ~50 below the floor (Hill form); final centering is K/s/k_h calibration.
